title: Detecting and explaining clinical-omics inconsistencies to improve patient cohort stratification: an application to Parkinson's disease
abstract: arXiv:2507.03656v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Discrepancies between clinical diagnoses and omics profiles within a characterized cohort may reflect misdiagnosis, hidden subgroups or prodromal disease states. We propose MLASDO, a tool to detect and characterize such discrepancies before downstream analyses. MLASDO (1) detects outliers using two unsupervised methods, thereby flagging potential poor-quality samples; and (2) identifies and characterizes anomalous samples (ASs), i.e., individuals whose molecular profile resembles the opposite clinical class. We applied MLASDO to the Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative (PPMI) and Parkinson's Disease Biomarkers Program (PDBP) Parkinson's disease (PD) cohorts. In PPMI, it detected 26 outliers and 12 ASs: 5 anomalous healthy controls (AHCs) and 7 anomalous PD cases (APDs). translated_title: 检测并解释临床-组学数据不一致性以改进患者队列分层：在帕金森病中的应用
translated_abstract: 在已明确表征的队列中，临床诊断与组学数据之间的差异可能反映误诊、隐藏亚群或疾病前驱状态。我们提出了MLASDO，一种用于在下游分析之前检测和表征此类差异的工具。MLASDO：(1) 使用两种无监督方法检测离群值，从而标记潜在的劣质样本；(2) 识别并表征异常样本（ASs），即其分子谱特征与相反临床类别相似的个体。我们将MLASDO应用于帕金森病进展标志物计划（PPMI）和帕金森病生物标志物计划（PDBP）的帕金森病（PD）队列。在PPMI中，MLASDO检测到26个离群值和12个异常样本：其中5个为异常健康对照（AHCs），7个为异常PD病例（APDs）。AHCs表现出比对照组更高的脑脊液（CSF）Aβ1-42水平（P < 0.0396），提示其对认知衰退具有抵抗力。AHC特异性基因w（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出MLASDO工具，通过无监督方法检测临床诊断与分子组学数据之间的不一致性（包括离群值和分子特征与临床类别相反的异常样本），从而在下游分析前识别误诊、隐藏亚群或前驱疾病状态，改进帕金森病等疾病的患者队列分层质量。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes MLASDO, a tool that uses unsupervised methods to detect and characterize clinical-omics inconsistencies—outliers and anomalous samples whose molecular profiles resemble the opposite clinical class—thereby improving patient cohort stratification, as demonstrated on Parkinson's disease cohorts from PPMI and PDBP.
